llm.summary: This skill only changes response style to be shorter, with no code execution or data access, but its broad triggers and hedging guidance deserve user awareness.

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no filesystem, network, credential, account, or mutation authority; its behavior is limited to answer style.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains a single Markdown skill file and no executable scripts, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, hooks, or tool modifications.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Some triggers such as "tokens", "efficiency", "communication", and "directness" are broad enough to activate outside explicit compression requests, and one hedging-removal example is overconfident, though later text preserves factual uncertainty markers.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, background worker, memory write, scheduled task, privilege escalation, or cross-session hook is present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently describes response compression: removing filler, redundant framing, and unnecessary verbosity while preserving safety warnings, technical precision, and needed context.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want shorter, more direct responses. Be aware it may activate from broad wording like discussions of efficiency or communication, so users who need nuanced explanations, safety-sensitive advice, or careful uncertainty should invoke it deliberately or narrow the triggers.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger terms are related to the response-compression purpose, but several are generic and may cause unintended activation during normal discussions; this is a usability and calibration concern rather than evidence of harmful behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: Removing unnecessary hedging fits the stated compression goal, and the artifact also says to preserve safety warnings and factual uncertainty markers, so the scanner concern is downgraded to user guidance rather than a Review verdict.
